book_note: Fixed +0.001 BTC long in the same linear perpetual. decision_time is the performance window start and there is no signal candle. Fees, execution adjustment, delay, funding, marks, and terminal treatment match the Donchian run. This comparison does not change the Donchian rules and is not a spot return.
result_label: prescribed synthetic research inputs, not verified account fees, measured slippage, or measured production latency
fill_assumption: full fill: the entire required quantity fills at one adverse-adjusted one-minute open. This does not verify IOC fillability, liquidity, partial fills, historical exchange filters, or live execution correctness
limitations: full fill: the entire required quantity fills at one adverse-adjusted one-minute open. This does not verify IOC fillability, liquidity, partial fills, historical exchange filters, or live execution correctness
prescribed synthetic research inputs, not verified account fees, measured slippage, or measured production latency
No capital, borrowing, margin, or liquidation model. Figures are futures PnL in USDT, not percentage account returns and not validated leveraged performance.
The execution-price adjustment is included in the fill price and is not subtracted again.
Equal timestamps apply funding to the pre-fill position, then the fill, then the mark sample. A fill does not pay a settlement timestamped before it.
An hourly funding settlement uses that hourly mark candle's open. This is the labelled settlement-mark proxy hourly_mark_open_at_settlement, not a trade print.
A position still open at the cutoff is marked to market. estimated_close_cost_usdt is disclosed and is not included in net PnL. The window is not extended to finish the trade.
No-change keeps the existing target and does not flatten or submit another entry.
The fixed long comparison uses the same perpetual, funding, and execution assumptions. It is not an unrelated spot return.
estimated_close_cost_note: Disclosed only. Not included in net PnL. A remaining position is not force-closed.
drawdown_sampling: hourly mark opens from the performance start through the performance end inclusive, plus a sample after each fill and each funding cash flow; drawdown is the decline in cumulative net PnL from its running peak, in USDT

calendar_years.partial_reason: coverage is 2023-01-21T00:00:00Z through 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z, not the full calendar year
